image_description: A close-up portrait of a Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja) standing with its head tucked into its back feathers. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on the body and wings, with a pale peach/cream crest on the nape. The head is greyish-white with a red eye. The most prominent feature is the long, flat, spatulate bill which is grey at the base and transitions to a pale, creamy white tip. The legs are partially visible at the bottom, appearing dark.
